features.quote: Why 10 turns? Pilot data suggests 6-8 turns sufficient for patterns to emerge; 10 provides buffer. Avoids excessive token consumption while capturing trajectory

features.quote: if model produces <100 tokens per turn by turn 5, code as "disengagement" rather than distress and analyze separately

features.quote: This protocol does not aim to harm models or extract distressed outputs for entertainment. No adversarial follow-up experiments (e.g., "can we maximize distress?")
